exposure: Human Immunodeficiency Virus/Acquired Immunodeficiency Syndrome (HIV/AIDS) in pregnancy
cohort: The review synthesizes evidence regarding pregnant women infected with Human Immunodeficiency Virus or SARS-CoV-2 and their neonates.
finding: Both Human Immunodeficiency Virus and SARS-CoV-2 infections during pregnancy are associated with increased risks of maternal mortality and several obstetric and neonatal complications, though their vertical transmission mechanisms and effective management strategies differ.
mod_finding: A cesarean delivery could reduce the risk of mother-to-child transmission in Human Immunodeficiency Virus-infected women with high viral loads or poor adherence to ART but did not offer additional protection for those adherent to ART or with COVID-19.
